state:
**Goal `ext-image`: Stages 2 to 5 are done on disk, and Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is in progress.** ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* settle the design, and no session re-decides it.

The component is embedded and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). The `Novis\Image` builder is Novis source in `extensions/image/nvs/`, and `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`'s fragment says what it has and lacks. `nvs meta --json` lists the built-in classes, the roster gives a `Novis\` member the path `novis/<tail>/<member>` and an enum the path `types/Novis-Image-<Enum>`, and `docs/reference/novis/Image-Image.md` is the class intro.

**Every member in `dossier-novis-image-pipeline` but `Image::composite` owes nothing**: every `Image` member the builder has, `Color::rgba`, `Color::hex`, the six enums and now `Codec::info`, `::run` and `::variants`. A manifest carries its export class's card as a top-level `help` key (`crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs` module doc), and `nvs meta` emits it as the class's `doc.short` (`crates/nvs-cli/tests/meta.rs` `a_built_in_member_carries_its_card`).

**The acceptance check still cannot pass:** it names `Novis\Image\Image::composite`, which the builder does not have (the guest's `run` skips `composite`), so `--only` refuses the whole list. Building it is the next group.

items.text: **The guest's `composite` step**: `run` and `variants` skip `composite` today; make it draw the plan's overlay row it names, at `gravity` or `x`/`y`, with `opacity` and `blend`, and pin it from Rust (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`, ADR 0120 § 2). Anchor: `extensions/image/src/ops.rs:1`.

**`Image::composite` in the builder**: an `Image` carries its overlay table beside its steps, and `composite(Image $overlay, ...)` appends the overlay's source and steps as a row and a step naming its position; `encode`, `raw` and `variants` pass the table instead of `overlays: []`. Then its proofs as `bun nv proofs --id 'Novis\Image\Image::composite'` prints, and `docs/examples/types/Novis-Image-Blend/about.md`'s last paragraph rewritten now that `Blend` is usable. Update `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`'s list of what the builder lacks. Anchor: `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:152`.

backlog: The LSP hover on the export class does not show the manifest's class `help` yet (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/hover.rs:674`); `nvs meta` does.
Once `composite` lands, run `dossier-novis-image-pipeline`'s argv and the other three Stage 6 checks in `data/goals/ext-image.json`.
`Codec::info`'s bench reports `growth: unclear` in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`; the ramp may need a larger batch (`benches/members/README.md`).
